HediffDef.label: vivi fairy
HediffDef.description: The souls of billions of vivis forcibly bound to the last queen of the ancient empire surround Apocrypha. Because the bound fairy vivis absorb every blow in her place, ordinary attacks cannot harm her. \nA vivi with fairy interference can approach Apocrypha to trigger a mana backflow in the bond network, freeing a large number of fairies at once.

HediffDef.label: primordial carapace
HediffDef.description: The carapace of the progenitor hornet, hardened by mana condensed over centuries. Reduces incoming damage by 99%. \nEach completed everflower attunement ritual unleashes a resonance wave that cracks the carapace and progressively weakens its damage reduction.
